title: Hermes
description: Hermes Agent from Nous Research as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on your own Hermes over ACP with Tomrade's tools, a ticket can also go to Hermes in a terminal, its own sessions report to Tomrade once connected, and its sign-in answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Connecting Hermes writes Tomrade's reporting plugin into ~/.hermes/plugins and reads ~/.hermes/config.yaml; a background call keeps its usage file in a temporary folder.
why.exec: Runs your own `hermes` command: its ACP server for conversations, `hermes config` and `hermes plugins` to connect it, and `hermes -z` for background calls.
